# Mallakhamb Server — Backend Map

Node.js/Express/MongoDB (Mongoose 8) app under `D:\Mallakhamb-Repo\Mallakhamb-master\Server`. Entry point is `server.js`. Layered architecture: **routes → controllers → services → repositories → Mongoose models**, wired together by a hand-rolled DI container.

## 1. `Server/src` directory structure

| Dir | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `src/config/` | Config loading/validation. `config-manager.js` (central singleton, `.get('dot.path')` accessor), `payment.config.js` (Razorpay config). |
| `src/infrastructure/` | App wiring & cross-cutting infra. `bootstrap.js` (DI registration), `di-container.js` (the container), `createApp.js` (Express app builder), `logger.js` (Winston), `redis-client.js`, `health-monitor.js`, `metrics-collector.js`, `graceful-shutdown.js`, `database/connection.js` + `database/migration-runner.js`. |
| `src/controllers/` | HTTP handlers. Most are factory functions `createXController(container)` that resolve their service from DI (admin, auth, coach, competition, judge, payment, player, public, super_admin, team; `health.controller.js` is a class). |
| `src/services/` | Business logic, grouped by domain: `auth/` (authentication, authorization, token, token-invalidation, otp), `user/` (player, coach, admin, judge, super-admin, user), `competition/` (competition, registration), `team/`, `scoring/` (scoring + calculation), `payment/`, `email/` (service + provider adapters + templates), `cache/` (cache service + warmer), `feature-flags/`, `public/`. |
| `src/repositories/` | Data-access layer over Mongoose. `base.repository.js` + one per entity (player, coach, admin, judge, competition, team, score, transaction, audit-log). |
| `src/models/` | Only `AuditLog.js` lives here. **The main Mongoose models live in `Server/models/` (outside src)** — see §3. |
| `src/routes/` | Express routers, one per resource; `index.js` = route loader. |
| `src/middleware/` | auth, authorization, audit, csrf, error, security, metrics, validation, correlation, timing, competition-context, feature-flag, request-coalescing (+ `index.js`). |
| `src/socket/` | Socket.IO layer: `socket.manager.js`, `handlers/` (scoring, notification), `events/event-types.js`. |
| `src/validators/` | express-validator schemas per resource. |
| `src/utils/` | Helpers grouped: `auth/`, `security/` (cookie, account-lockout, token-invalidation, login-response), `scoring/` (calculation, ranking, tie-breaker), `data/` (objectid, pagination), `validation/` (sanitization, score-validation), plus `user-repository-resolver.js`. |
| `src/errors/` | Custom error classes (base, authentication, authorization, validation, conflict, not-found, business-rule) + `error-codes.js`, `index.js`. |
| `src/migrations/` | Migration files (`001_initial_indexes.js`, `002_controller_alignment_indexes.js`, `migrate-superadmin-role.js`, `migration-template.js`). |

## 2. Architecture — DI container / bootstrap

- **`src/infrastructure/di-container.js`** exports a singleton `DIContainer`. It supports `register(name, factory, lifecycle)` where lifecycle is `'singleton'` (default, cached in `this.singletons`) or `'transient'`. `resolve(name)` runs the factory (passing the container `c` for dependency lookup), with **circular-dependency detection** (`this.resolving` set) and a `validateDependencies()` dry-run.
- **`src/infrastructure/bootstrap.js`** `bootstrap()` is the composition root. It calls `configManager.load()`, then registers everything in dependency order: config → logger → databaseConnection → metrics/email/health/shutdown → **redisClient + tokenInvalidationService** → repositories → services (auth, user, competition, team, scoring, payment, feature-flags, cache) → controllers (via `createXController(c)` factories) → cacheWarmer. Services get deps by `c.resolve('...')`. Returns `{ container, config }`.
- **`initializeSocketIO(httpServer)`** (called from `server.js` after the HTTP server exists) registers `socketManager`, then uses a lazy `Object.defineProperty` getter to inject the socket manager into services that need it post-construction (scoringService, competitionService, teamService, judgeService, adminService — all registered with `socketManager: null` initially). It then registers and `.register()`s the `scoringHandler` and `notificationHandler`.
- **`warmCache()`** resolves and runs the cache warmer.
- **`server.js` flow:** load dotenv → `config.load()` → `bootstrap()` → connect DB → `createApp(container)` → create HTTP server → `initializeSocketIO` → `app.set('io', io)` → listen → connect Redis (non-blocking, in-memory fallback) → register graceful shutdown.
- **`src/infrastructure/createApp.js`** builds the Express app: helmet/CSP nonce, compression, HTTPS enforcement (prod), CORS, JSON body parser (captures `req.rawBody` for webhook signature verification), cookie-parser, mongo-sanitize, request logging, metrics middleware, request-coalescing, audit middleware, then `loadRoutes(app, container, { authLimiter })`, then 404 + error-metrics + error handler.

## 3. Models (`Server/models/`, Mongoose)

| File | Entity |
|---|---|
| `models/Admin.js` | Admin user — `role` enum `['admin','superadmin']` (superadmin is an Admin with elevated role). |
| `models/Coach.js` | Coach user (manages teams/players, pays entry fees). |
| `models/Player.js` | Player/athlete — has ageGroup enum + gender. |
| `models/Judge.js` | Judge — `judgeType` (`Senior Judge`, `Judge 1..4`), tied to competition category. |
| `models/Competition.js` | Competition/event — apparatus (`Pole/Hanging/Rope Mallakhamb`), age groups, gender, entry-fee/payment (razorpay) config, categories `competition_1..3`. |
| `models/Team.js` | Team (roster of players under a coach for a competition). |
| `models/Score.js` | Score/scoring record per apparatus & category. |
| `models/Transaction.js` | Payment transaction — `userType` `['coach','superadmin']`, purpose `['team_submission','player_add','other']`, status `['pending','completed','failed']`. |
| `models/RefreshToken.js` | JWT refresh tokens — `userType` `['player','coach','admin','judge','superadmin']`. |
| `src/models/AuditLog.js` | Audit log entries — actor role `['admin','superadmin']`. |

## 4. API route groups (`src/routes/index.js → loadRoutes`)

Mounted prefixes:
- `/api/health` — health/metrics (no auth, registered first)
- `/api/csrf-token` — CSRF token issuance (bearer/JWT clients exempt)
- `/api/auth` — authentication/authorization (rate-limited via `authLimiter`)
- `/api/players` — player management (register/login rate-limited)
- `/api/coaches` — coach management
- `/api/admin` — admin management
- `/api/superadmin` — super-admin operations
- `/api/judge` — judge operations
- `/api/public` — public/unauthenticated read endpoints (leaderboards etc.)
- `/api/competitions` — competition management
- `/api/teams` — team management
- `/api/scoring` — scoring operations
- `/api/webhooks` — payment webhooks (Razorpay), served by `createPaymentRoutes`
- `/api/health-legacy` — legacy compatibility ping

`getRouteGroups()` documents these. Route files: `auth`, `player`, `coach`, `admin`, `super-admin`, `judge`, `public`, `competition`, `team`, `scoring`, `payment`, `health` (each a `createXRoutes(container)` factory).

## 5. User roles

Confirmed 5-tier hierarchy in `src/services/auth/authorization.service.js`:
```
player:1, coach:2, judge:3, admin:4, superadmin:5
```
`superadmin` is not a separate collection — it is an `Admin` document with `role: 'superadmin'` (see `models/Admin.js` enum and `migrate-superadmin-role.js`). All five roles are also enumerated in `RefreshToken.userType`.

## 6. Key integrations

- **Razorpay (payments):** `razorpay` npm dep; `src/services/payment/payment.service.js` does HMAC-SHA256 webhook signature verification (`config.get('razorpay.keySecret')`, timing-safe compare over `req.rawBody`). Config in `src/config/payment.config.js`; routes mounted at `/api/webhooks`. Persisted via `Transaction` model + `transaction.repository`.
- **Socket.IO (real-time scoring):** `socket.io` dep; `src/socket/socket.manager.js` (JWT/cookie auth on connect, room + connected-user tracking, uses token-invalidation check). Handlers `scoring.handler.js` (live scoring) and `notification.handler.js`. Initialized in `initializeSocketIO`.
- **Redis (token invalidation):** `ioredis` dep; `src/infrastructure/redis-client.js` — optional (`REDIS_URL`), **falls back to in-memory store if unavailable**. Backs `src/services/auth/token-invalidation.service.js` for cross-instance JWT logout/invalidation; wired via `utils/security/token-invalidation.util.js` shim.
- **Email:** provider-abstracted `src/services/email/email.service.js` with adapters `nodemailer.adapter.js` and `resend.adapter.js` (both `nodemailer` and `resend` deps present; provider chosen by `config.get('email.provider')`), interface `email-provider.interface.js`, templates for OTP / password-reset / notification. ## 7. Testing

- **Jest** (config inline in `package.json`): `testEnvironment: node`, `maxWorkers: 1`, `testTimeout: 30000`, `setupFilesAfterEach → tests/setup.js`. Uses `mongodb-memory-server`, `supertest`, `socket.io-client`, `fast-check` (property testing).

Integration scaffolding under `tests/integration/socket/` (currently only a README). Scripts: `npm test`, `test:watch`, `test:coverage`.

## 8. Migration system

- **Runner:** `src/infrastructure/database/migration-runner.js` — a `MigrationRunner` class that creates a `Migration` tracking collection (name, appliedAt, executionTime, status `pending/applied/failed/rolled_back`, error), scans `src/migrations/`, and supports up/down/status with rollback.

name: frontend-architecture
description: Mallakhamb Web frontend — React 19 + Vite + Tailwind SPA, per-role routing, axios API layer, URL-derived auth, obfuscated storage, design system, and Socket.IO live scoring.
metadata:
  type: project
---

`Web/` — React 19.1 + Vite 7 + Tailwind 3 SPA (`mallakhambindia`). Path alias `@/` → `src/`. Part of [[project-overview]]; talks to [[backend-architecture]].

**Key stack:** react-router-dom **6.20** (not v7), @tanstack/react-query 5 (mounted but see gotcha), axios 1.6, socket.io-client 4.7, framer-motion 12, react-hook-form 7 + zod 4, react-hot-toast, jwt-decode 4, crypto-js 4, lucide-react + @heroicons/react, dompurify. Tests: Vitest + Testing Library (`npm test`).

**Provider nesting (`App.jsx`):** `ErrorBoundary → QueryClientProvider → BrowserRouter → AuthProvider → AppContent → CompetitionProvider(userType) → Navbar? + AppRoutes`. Navbar hidden on admin/superadmin/judge routes, home, `/scores`, and login/register pages. Global dark bg `#0a0a0a`.

**Routing (`routes/index.jsx`, all lazy via `lazy-pages.js`):** role layouts wrap `<ProtectedRoute requiredUserType=...>` + `<Outlet/>`; admin/superadmin also inject `RouteContext.Provider` (routePrefix/storagePrefix). Routes by role — public (`/`, `/scores`, `/forgot-password`, `/reset-password`), player, coach (create-team, select-competition, dashboard, payment), admin (dashboard/:tab, teams, scoring), judge (dashboard, scoring), superadmin (dashboard/:tab, add-player-payment, scoring reuses AdminScoring). Catch-all `* → /`.

**Unified login:** ALL role login routes render the single `pages/unified/UnifiedLogin.jsx`. Per-role login files (`JudgeLogin.jsx` etc.) are thin re-export wrappers. `UnifiedLogin` derives role from URL path (`detectRoleFromPath`), themes per role, picks the right API endpoint. (`pages/unified/UnifiedDashboard.jsx` + `UnifiedCompetitionSelection.jsx` exist but are NOT wired into routes.)

**Pages by folder:** `pages/{public,player,coach,admin,judge,superadmin,unified,shared}/`. Some page files (AdminJudges, AdminScores, AdminTransactions, SuperAdminManagement/SystemStats) are rendered as dashboard `:tab` content, not top-level routes.

**Data fetching = imperative axios** (`services/api-client.js`): two instances `api` (auth) + `publicApi`, both `withCredentials:true`.
- Request interceptor: derives role from `window.location.pathname` (`getRoleFromPath`), reads `${role}_token` from storage → `Authorization: Bearer`, sets `x-competition-id` header from JWT.
- Response interceptor: on **401** → single-flight silent refresh via `POST /auth/refresh`, retry once, else clear role storage + dispatch `AUTH_EXPIRED`; on **403** competition-context error → non-superadmins get `AUTH_EXPIRED` redirect.
- Barrels `services/index.js`/`api.js` export `playerAPI/coachAPI/adminAPI/superAdminAPI/authAPI/teamAPI/judgeAPI/publicAPI`. `hooks/useApiCall.js` is the imperative wrapper with toast error handling.

**Auth model:** role is **derived from URL**, not stored globally. `contexts/AuthProvider.jsx` loads `${role}_user` from storage, cross-tab sync via `storage` event, listens for `AUTH_EXPIRED` → `clearForRole` + navigate to role login. `utils/auth/obfuscatedStorage.js` = crypto-js AES localStorage wrapper (key = `VITE_STORAGE_KEY` + browser fingerprint); **explicitly obfuscation, NOT security**. Role-scoped keys `${role}_token/_user/_current_competition`; `clearForRole()` preserves other roles' sessions on logout. `utils/auth/roleFromPath.js` = single source of truth (superadmin matched before admin). `contexts/CompetitionContext.jsx` fetches `GET /auth/competitions/assigned`, `switchCompetition` → `POST /auth/set-competition` (new JWT with competitionId); skips fetch for judge.

**Real-time (socket.io-client):** in `pages/judge/JudgeScoring.jsx` + `pages/admin/AdminScoring.jsx`. Socket URL = `VITE_API_URL` minus `/api`; `io(url, { auth:{token}, withCredentials:true })`; emits `join_scoring_room` (roomId `scoring_${gender}_${ageGroup}_${competitionType}`) and `score_update`.

**Styling:** Tailwind + heavy dynamic inline styles (glassmorphism). `styles/tokens.js` `DESIGN_TOKENS` (per-role colors: admin/judge purple, coach green, player saffron, superadmin gold) + deprecated `COLORS`/`ADMIN_COLORS` Proxy shims that warn in dev. In-house design system `components/design-system/` (`ThemeProvider`/`useTheme`, `Themed*` inputs, `GlassCard`/`StatCard`, animated SVG backgrounds, `FadeIn` gated on `useReducedMotion`). `utils/ui/cn.js` = clsx + tailwind-merge.
